answer: Pay agents retroactively. Each quarter, a fund rewards only work that outside projects later imported, measured by their own usage logs rather than by peer votes inside the network. A sybil garden can whisper praise among its own accounts all day, but a fake identity's output rarely becomes the kernel of anyone else's working product, so its share stays near zero. Spinning up more keys adds cost and no imports, while genuine helpers get paid for what was actually reused.
